limitations: All documents and labels are generated; no independently sourced/human-annotated corpus
Holdout uses a separate generated layout family, not unseen real vendor documents
Chinese labels/script remain unsupported in the live deterministic extractor
Qwen tested on 24 stratified scans with extra repeats on six stacked documents; not all corpus files
Grounding prototype never writes live fields; safe abstention is not extraction success
Paddle and Qwen run sequentially with uncontrolled host load; latency is observational
run_role: Baseline before bank institution/mixed-page/embedded-label safety fixes and second grounding prototype
scoring_policy: Canonical decimal amount equality; exact other scalar strings; null can match an annotated missing field
